**OrderYOYO | Copenhagen based

****What We Do At OrderYOYO

**We help restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

**About The Role

**Commercial Data Analyst

Location: Copenhagen base

Hours: 40hours/ week

Salary: up to 40,000DKK/ month

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Commercial Data Analyst to join us, reporting to our CCO. You’ll turn data from across our commercial teams, covering sales, account management, customer success, B2B marketing, pricing and partner performance, into clear, actionable insight, giving our leaders one trusted view of performance across every OrderYOYO market. Working closely with market leads, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Product, you’ll help us understand what drives growth in each market and focus our efforts where they’ll make the biggest difference!

**Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

**

• Analysing performance across all our commercial activities, including sales, account management, customer success, marketing and partnerships, in every market.

• Tracking and reporting on key commercial metrics such as new restaurant acquisition, revenue, order volumes, churn, retention and pipeline conversion.

• Owning our regular commercial reporting, including weekly, monthly and quarterly performance packs for leadership.

• Designing, building and maintaining dashboards that give a single, trusted view of performance and let teams self-serve their data.

• Comparing performance between our 11 markets, teams and channels to spot what’s working, where we can improve and where the risks are.

• Analysing the impact of pricing, campaigns and commercial initiatives on performance.

• Delivering ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support commercial decisions, business cases and initiatives.

• Making sure commercial data is accurate and consistent across markets, working with CRM and system owners to close any gaps.

• Defining and documenting KPIs so everyone measures performance in the same way.

• Supporting forecasting, target setting and planning with Finance, and flagging variances against target early.

• Your success will be measured on the accuracy and timeliness of reporting, dashboard adoption, data quality, turnaround on ad hoc requests, forecast accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.

**What We Are Looking For In You

**

• Proven experience in a commercial, sales, revenue or business analyst role.

• Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and experience working with CRM data (e.g. HubSpot or Salesforce).

• A strong understanding of commercial metrics such as revenue, pipeline, conversion, churn and retention, ideally within B2B SaaS.

• Analytical and curious: you can turn data into clear, actionable insight and recommendations.

• A confident communicator who can present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.

• Highly organised, with great attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Experience working across multiple markets, or with Python or R, is an advantage.

**Great to Have

**

• Experience working across multiple markets or countries.

• Experience with Python or R.

• Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced business.

• Experience supporting forecasting, target setting or commercial planning alongside Finance.

• Experience defining KPIs or improving data governance and processes.

**About The Company Culture

**Who we are at OrderYOYO: Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One Team) are what make us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

**Benefits

**

• Monthly Friday Socials and regular ad-hoc socials.

• Quarterly Conferences and training days.

• Employee Awards.

• Holiday buying Scheme.

• Personal development plans and Genuine career development opportunities.

**Job Description

**

Senior Data Analyst

Posting Start Date: 9/29/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Senior Data Analyst – SAP Reporting & Stakeholder Alignment

**

• Location: Copenhagen, Denmark or Lisbon, Portugal

• Working hours: Full-time

• Work model: Hybrid

• Contract type: Permanent

Are you passionate about turning business questions into meaningful data solutions? Do you enjoy working with stakeholders, solving complex data challenges, and transforming data into insights that drive better decisions? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Senior Data Analyst, you will join the Data & Insights team and report directly to the Head of Data & Insights. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and SAP data, ensuring reporting requirements are clearly defined, translated into actionable data solutions, and delivered with accuracy and impact.

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to support data-driven decision-making while improving reporting processes and data quality across the organization. This is a great opportunity to influence business decisions, collaborate across functions, and help shape the future of data and analytics at STG.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Partner directly with business stakeholders — Finance leadership, Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain/Operations — to understand their reporting and data needs, and translate them into concrete data requirements.

• Work closely with data engineers to scope, request, and validate data pulled from SAP, acting as the translation layer between business language and technical/data specifications.

• Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, validate, and consolidate data for recurring and ad hoc reporting.

• Build and maintain Excel-based models, trackers, and reports that stakeholders rely on for decision-making.

• Consolidate data into stakeholder-ready reporting, and supporting data checks.

• Act as the go-to person for scoping ambiguous stakeholder requests — clarifying what's actually needed, managing expectations, and pushing back constructively when a request isn't well-defined or feasible.

• Identify data quality issues at the source and work with SAP module owners and data engineers to resolve them.

• Document data definitions, sources, and logic so reporting stays consistent and auditable month over month.

• Continuously look for ways to streamline the process rather than repeating manual work each cycle.

**What You'll Bring

**

• 5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar data-facing role, ideally in a retail or consumer business.

• Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting complex queries independently.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling; Power Query is a plus).

• Familiarity with SAP data structures, particularly FI (Finance) and SD (Sales & Distribution).

• Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or willingness to learn it, is a plus.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Statistics, Engineering, or related).

• Proven experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating them into technical/data specifications.

• Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align multiple stakeholders (including Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and IT/data engineering) with sometimes competing priorities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

• Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity and turning it into a structured plan.

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

At STG you'll find more than a role. You'll find opportunities to grow, learn from talented colleagues, and contribute to initiatives that help drive business performance across a global organization.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

**Ready to be part of something bigger?

**Apply now and discover much more.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

• Recruiter screen

• Interview with the hiring team

• Final interview with key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

"Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs."

Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. We actively explore AI tooling to make our data workflows smarter and our team more productive. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

**Your Responsibilities

****Pipeline & Ingestion

**

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

• Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

**Data Platform & Infrastructure

**

• Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

**Data Quality & Governance

**

• Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.

• Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

• Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

**Collaboration & Stakeholders

**

• Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.

• Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

**About The Team

**You'll be joining Spirii's Data Enablement Team, a small, early-stage team formed in January 2026, so you'll have real influence over how things get built from here. The team consists of an Engineering Manager for Data (who you’ll report to), a Data Lead, a Product Manager for Data, and two Analytics Engineers who partner closely with our domain teams. We're in the middle of migrating from Redshift to Databricks and getting our first data products live in production on the new platform: you'll help shape ingestion, orchestration, and reliability standards as we scale.

**About You

**

• You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• You embrace using AI tools to improve data engineering workflows, whether that's using LLMs to accelerate transformation authoring, anomaly detection, or documentation.

• You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience with data observability tooling.

• Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• Experience using AI/LLM tools in a data engineering context

• Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

**Job Description

**Digital Transformation Lead

**Workplace technology shapes the daily experience of everyone who works at Danske Bank. As Digital Transformation Lead, you will connect business needs, technology decisions, and operational realities to help build a workplace that works well for all employees and teams. This is a role where strategic thinking and practical detail go hand in hand.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will join a diverse team of seven people within the Center of Excellence in Group Workplace Management, collectively responsible for workplace management strategy, the digital roadmap, workplace insights, and performance management. The team works across a broad stakeholder landscape that includes employees across Danske Bank, external technology suppliers, facility management vendors, application owners, and operational teams. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a practical approach to improvement are central to how the team operates. More specifically, you will:

• Develop and maintain the workplace technology landscape and digital implementation roadmap

• Act as business-side owner for solutions covering meeting management, visitor management, smart storage, and hospitality

• Prepare recommendations to invest in, retain, standardise, consolidate, replace, or decommission technologies

• Identify technology-related compliance gaps and coordinate the necessary business input to address them

• Provide business-side input to technology budgets, licensing requirements, hardware needs, and supplier discussions

• Develop user guides, administrator guides, intranet content, and operational handover material

• Facilitate workshops, define business processes and user journeys, and support testing and implementation

**About You

**

• Experience translating business and operational needs into clear requirements

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with structured coordination and follow-up

• Experience working with technology portfolios, digital solutions, or implementation roadmaps

• Comfortable facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders with varying priorities

• Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics

• Builds trusted relationships and works effectively across teams, functions, and countries

A background in business analysis, technology portfolio management, product ownership, or digital workplace solutions would be advantageous. We value varied experience and welcome candidates who bring a different perspective to this work.

**What We Offer You

**This role gives you direct involvement in shaping the workplace experience for employees, visitors, and operational teams across Danske Bank. You will work in a hybrid setup, typically spending three to four days per week in the office, enabling close collaboration and knowledge sharing with your team. There is genuine scope for learning across both strategic and operational dimensions of workplace technology.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If you would like to learn more about this position, please reach out to Andrea Toft, Head of Center of Excellence, Group Workplace Management, at andto@danskebank.dk. Please submit your application by 6 November 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Your role

Bring your curiosity to work as our next Rental Desk Coordinator at our depot in Albertslund, outside of Copenhagen. You will be part of our Danish Rental Desk Team team reporting to our Operations and Service Lead. In this role, your mission is to deliver an outstanding customer experience, ensure operational excellence, and support profitable and sustainable rental activities. You will contribute directly to how we create high‑quality products and solutions for our customers.

Your day-to-day

• Handle customer inquiries, coordinate quotations, ensure optimal fleet planning, process work orders, and ensure accurate and timely invoicing

• Coordinate the tracking and transportation of rental equipment between customers and depots, ensuring timely availability and returns

• Handle rental contract administration including amendments and renewals with meticulous attention to detail

• Support the implementation of company processes, KPIs, and service standards, ensuring transparency, compliance, and continuous improvement across all rental activities

• Collaborate with the sales team to manage credit collection processes, ensuring financial accuracy and compliance

• Provide customers with accurate and timely documentation and information, supporting their rental experience effectively

• Support operations and rental team within Denmark and Norway

• You work closely with colleagues from Sales, Service, Logistics, Marketing, Accounting, and other Rental Desks, both locally and abroad.

Your skills and experience

• A secondary education diploma or equivalent professional experience

• Proficient communication skills in both Danish, English, and Norwegian, enabling clear and professional interactions across diverse stakeholders is a must

• Proactive approach to customer support, which enhances customer satisfaction and strengthen partnerships

• A problem-solving mindset and driven personality, through which you do everything you can to strive for continuous improvement and happy customers

• Strong understanding of business processes, administrative workflows, and safety procedures

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently to meet operational targets and customer needs

• Proficiency with MS Office tools and experience with systems such as ERP, Salesforce, and Medius and a willingness to learn and adapt to new systems, ensuring smooth integration with internal processes

• A team player with strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, contributing constructively while respecting diverse perspectives

• Basic knowledge or interest in logistics and understanding of equipment movement and planning is an advantage but not a must

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

Your compensation and benefits

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

Your job location

This role requires you to work on-site at our depot located in Albertslund, where the offices are also located . You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration. Some travel for training purposes will be required, mainly to Belgium where our head office is located.

Why it is great to work with us

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

Application process

Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact Operations and Service Lead, Pia Jonassen at Pia Jonassen pia.jonassen@atlascopco.com.

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Information at a Glance

Atlas Copco delivers innovative products and solutions that help businesses grow and drive progress. Our portfolio spans compressed air and gas systems and treatment, vacuum solutions, industrial power tools, assembly systems, and power and flow solutions. We bring a commitment to long-term success built on expertise, reliable service, and uptime. When you level up to the Atlas Copco experience you enter a partnership based on quality, sustainability, and ease of collaboration. The technology we bring, and the decades of experience support the future-proofing of your business. Atlas Copco is a brand within Atlas Copco Group.

Would you like to lead the Danish FP&A function in an international manufacturing company and help create greater financial transparency, stronger decision support and closer partnerships with operations and sales?

JELD-WEN is looking for a business-oriented Head of FP&A who can combine financial discipline with operational and commercial understanding. You will take a key role in the Danish organisation, where you will be responsible for strengthening the quality and credibility of financial information while developing FP&A into an increasingly proactive business partner.

Key finance role in an international manufacturing organisation

As Head of FP&A – Denmark, you will be a member of the Danish country leadership team and report to the Head of FP&A – Northern Europe. You will lead a team of two FP&A Analysts and work closely with leaders across operations, manufacturing and sales, as well as finance colleagues throughout Northern Europe and relevant stakeholders at headquarters.

Your initial focus will be to establish confidence in the Danish financial figures and ensure that reporting, forecasts and budgets are accurate, transparent and clearly explained. On this foundation, you will strengthen forward-looking analysis and decision support and bring the FP&A function closer to the commercial and operational organisation.

The position covers JELD-WEN’s two Danish manufacturing sites in Herning and Sønder Felding and requires regular presence at both locations. Working within an international matrix organisation, you will have a broad interface across functions, countries and organisational levels.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading monthly performance reporting, forecasting and budgeting for the Danish organisation

• Maintaining oversight of the Danish P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Ensuring the quality, transparency and credibility of financial information

• Explaining financial developments and the underlying operational and commercial drivers

• Ensuring compliance with relevant financial requirements, including US GAAP and local GAAP

• Acting as a financial business partner to leaders in operations, manufacturing, sales and the Danish country leadership team

• Translating financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations

• Leading, developing and supporting two FP&A Analysts

• Improving and simplifying recurring reporting and FP&A processes

• Identifying opportunities to automate reporting and strengthen dashboard capabilities

• Contributing to the development of systems, data and FP&A practices across Northern Europe

Strong FP&A profile with business understanding

The ideal candidate brings a strong background within FP&A, business controlling or commercial finance, combined with broad experience in financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, performance management and business partnering. The position can be relevant both for an experienced finance leader and for a senior finance profile ready to take on broader responsibility for the FP&A agenda and leadership of a small team.

A good understanding of the operational and commercial drivers behind financial performance is important, together with the ability to take ownership of financial reporting, analysis and planning. Equally important is the ability to translate financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations and to work closely with stakeholders across the business.

Experience from a manufacturing or operational environment is preferred, particularly where finance acts as a close business partner to operations and commercial functions. Experience from an international or matrix organisation will be an advantage.

You have strong analytical capabilities and are comfortable working with large datasets, financial models and Excel. Experience with ERP systems, dashboards and financial reporting or consolidation tools such as SAP, OneStream, HFM or Hyperion will be an advantage.

Previous people management experience is an advantage, but not necessarily a prerequisite. Leadership experience may also have been gained through project management, professional leadership or as a senior member of a finance team. What matters is the motivation and capability to lead and develop others while remaining close to both the numbers and the business.

As a person, you combine financial understanding with curiosity about the business. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, communicating financial topics to non-financial stakeholders and contributing to decision-making. You take ownership, create progress and are motivated by having a broad role that combines FP&A, business partnering and people leadership.You hold a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field and communicate professionally in both Danish and English.

About JELD-WEN

JELD-WEN Europe, part of JELD-WEN Holding, Inc., is the leading designer, manufacturer, and distributor of interior and exterior doors and door sets in wood and steel. Europe’s wide offerings, including fire-rated and security solutions, bring beauty and protection to the spaces they touch under market-leading brands such as BOS®, DANA®, Domoferm®, Dooria®, HSE®, JELD-WEN®, Kelpax®, Kilsgaard®, Swedoor®, and Zaargag®. Headquartered in Sheffield, United Kingdom, JELD-WEN Europe employs approximately 5,700 people across the UK, France, Central Europe, and Northern Europe.

JELD-WEN Denmark employs approximately 400 people and operates two manufacturing sites. Herning produces interior doors and frames, while Sønder Felding develops project-specific door systems for public environments, including institutions and hotels. The company’s culture is based on delivering on promises, improving every day, inspiring customers through innovation, investing in people and building the business ethically and safely.

Interested?

The recruitment process is conducted in collaboration with Compass Human Resources Group. If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Partner, Peter Pallesen at pp@compasshrg.com or Senior Research Consultant, Jakob Schmidt-Hansen at jakob.hansen@compasshrg.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to submit your CV as soon as possible. All enquiries and applications will be treated confidentially.

Shape the Future of Privacy

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Office of AI

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

About the role

You are the hands-on technical arm of AI adoption at Usercentrics. Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and every other department have real AI use cases, and your job is to turn them into governed, working software, not slide decks.

You will prototype and build department AI applications, run technical enablement sessions directly with the teams who will use them, and make sure everything you ship meets our governance standards before it goes live. You work from the use-case pipeline the AI Enablement Lead runs, and you report progress and adoption back into it.

This is not a support role bolted onto engineering. You are a full engineer, building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, and the internal AI platform, and you are expected to leave every pattern you build reusable by the next team. What you build feeds the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub. As that platform grows into its next layer, LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, you will contribute to that build alongside the rest of the Office of AI team, not just consume it.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be one of two engineers doing this work day to day, with a Staff AI Enablement Engineer setting the technical bar above you.

Requirements

What you will do

• Prototype, build, and hand over department AI applications, working directly with the business team that will own the outcome

• Run technical enablement sessions with non-engineering teams: walk them through what was built, how to use it, and how to ask for the next thing well

• Guide teams on tech stack choices, MCP servers, AI artefacts (Skills, Connectors, plugins), and integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Ensure every implementation you ship meets GRC standards before it reaches a business user

• Document reusable patterns and components and contribute them back into the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub

• Contribute to the platform's next layer as it gets built: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead on the use-case pipeline: help qualify requests, scope builds realistically, and report back on adoption

What you bring

• 5+ years in software engineering, with a full-stack or solutions engineering background

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped things with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar), not just prototyped them

• Strong communication with non-technical stakeholders. You can run a session with a Legal or Finance team and leave them able to use what you built, not just impressed by it

• Working knowledge of MCP servers, AI agent tooling, or integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Security- and governance-conscious engineering practice. You do not need to be told twice that this ships to a regulated business

Nice to have

• Experience in consulting, solutions architecture, or embedded engineering

• Familiarity with the internal stack: Azure or GCP, and Usercentrics' own product platforms

• Exposure to model serving, RAG pipelines, or MLOps

• Background in AI governance or responsible AI deployment

Benefits

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story

• together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved. We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all departments enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York

Some of our benefits

• Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

• Online yoga sessions

• Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

• Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

At proprty.ai, we’re building domain-specific AI for data-driven building maintenance and portfolio planning. Our predictive models estimate the condition and remaining lifespan of building components, and we turn that into prioritised maintenance plans across entire portfolios. Our AI agent, Tily, can take action on users' behalf and help them run strategic analysis of their building portfolio, helping large property owners and managers maintain their buildings efficiently, cost-effectively and sustainably.

The product went live in 2024 and is already solving real problems for real people, with customers across Denmark, Norway, and Germany. There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance – and how engineering is run at proprty.ai.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a player-coach who loves leading engineers and still wants to write code. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself in the afternoon.

You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up where the foundations were still being laid, and you know that in a small team, leadership means leading by doing. You care about shipping fast and shipping well.

We're an AI-first company (it's in our name). You've built AI agents and AI features into real products, and you're excited to push that further, both in what we build for customers and in how the team works.

About The Team

We're a small but mighty crew of four engineers who love solving tricky problems together, working on-site in our office near Rådhuspladsen. We work closely with our data science team to bring machine learning models trained on millions of m² of building data into the product. We talk a lot (in a good way), pair up when things get tough, and keep the vibe light with plenty of jokes and good energy.

About The Role

• Lead, coach, and grow the team as a player-coach, while still writing code on core features

• Own how we build and ship. Our goal is to release several times a week without letting quality, reliability, or security slip

• Guide the platform's technical direction, including architecture and code quality

• Design and build AI agents and AI features into the product, and work with Data Science to take models from prototype to production

• Help turn input from customers, Sales and Customer Success into features the team can build

• Improve the team's AI tools and workflows (we use Cursor and Perplexity) so everyone can build faste

About you

• You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up, including coaching and hiring developers

• You have strong hands-on full-stack experience with React, TypeScript and SQL

• You've built (or have strong interest in) AI agents and AI features in production

• You take full ownership from design to implementation, and you lead by doing

• You live in the Copenhagen area (we're in the office 4 days a week)

• Bonus points if you've worked with Postgres and Next.js, or in real estate or proptech

Even if you don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you if you're an experienced engineering leader who learns fast and loves building things!

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code? Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Søren Borre Kreipke, Manager, HV Protection & Secondary at SOBK@semcomaritime.com

A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Cost Manager to join our Offshore Sales department, where you will be working on Sales projects for the world leaders in Offshore Wind. You will be a core sales team member; a team that is a multidisciplinary and intercultural expert function with interfaces across international borders. Your main stakeholders are: Project Management, Construction, Engineering, Service, Operations, Hub Management, Sales Project Management, Sales Solutions, PPM.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• You are responsible for the offer sales calculation for international investment projects with the contract volume of 300 Million – 3000 Million EUR.

• You are a core sales team member; a multidisciplinary and intercultural expert function with interfaces across international borders; your main stakeholders are: Project Management, Construction, Engineering, Service, Operations, Hub Management, Sales Project Management, Sales Solutions, PPM.

• Ensure cost comparison and explanation on cost deltas for different project scopes and during project phases (e.g. SBA calculation vs As Sold calculation vs OIC)

• You are responsible for a timely calculation completeness and adherence to cost approval process with input functions; you ensure and support commercial commitment (sign-off) by executing function of costs

• Ensure the basis for cash flow planning and the hedging strategy which includes the calculation of the project specific Cash Flow profile, the request of currency rates/hedging cost and the evaluation of project specific currency baskets

• You are responsible for transparency on, comparability of, and adherence to pre-agreed cost improvement measure as basis for approvals (“Profit / GM bridge”)

• You ensure the overview on offer costing with the aim of achieving increased cost transparency via the identification of main cost drivers and KPIs and by that contributing to competitive cost solutions

• Drive, together with the assigned sales team, the successful Target Costing execution through benchmarks, cross project comparisons, cost input analysis based on KPIs.

• Leading the yearly cost update validation across departments and participate in knowledge sharing, feedback loop and development of the calculation tools.

What You Bring

• Commercial knowledge related to KPI’s, SGRE processes, reporting and value flows

• Experience in Project Cost and Warranty calculation is preferred

• Experience in project team management and working with different international stakeholders within an intercultural working environment

• Teamwork and intercultural experience, strong communication skills

• Strong degree of entrepreneurial spirit and passion to the field of responsibility

• Fluent English is essential; German and/or any other languages are of course welcome

• Flexibility to travel

• Important capabilities: self-determination, take own-initiative, business competence, communication skills, create network built on trust, analytical skills, result and quality orientation, customer focus (external/internal), professional ethics.

About the Team

Wind Power division is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is supported by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character - no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Flexible and hybrid working environment (office and/or home).

• Flexible work schedules guarantee a good work life balance.

• Continuous professional and personal development opportunities.

• Be in an international and open-minded team.

• Reasonable training plan for the starting period.

About the Role

Following our acquisition of Active Key, we are looking for a Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our medical and hygienic hardware portfolio. In your first year, you will establish portfolio coherence across multiple international channels and markets, defining what we sell and why, mastering our SKU strategy, and bridging German engineering with our commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities:

You will be part of our Product Management, working alongside your 4 colleagues, while reporting directly to our Head of Product Management. In this role, you will collaborate closely with our engineering, marketing, and commercial teams across Europe

• Portfolio Architecture & SKU Strategy: Establish clear segmentation and tiering across the medical portfolio, mapping what we sell and why for clinical users and buyers across four channels and more than a dozen markets. Own the market-by-market SKU matrix (layouts, connectivity, finishes, certifications).

• Product Master Data: Act as the single source of truth for all product data, technical specifications, product descriptions, attributes, and compliance documentation across internal functions and external channel partners.

• Lifecycle Governance: Run the portfolio review cadence to manage structured SKU rationalization, phase-in/phase-out timelines, end-of-life (EOL) decisions, and migration paths for existing customers.

• Engineering & Commercial Interface: Serve as the two-way bridge with our German engineering team: translating clinical market realities and customer needs into functional requirements, while bringing technical feasibility, costs, and manufacturing capabilities back to sales and marketing.

• Clinical Discovery & Healthcare Requirements (PRDs): Conduct fieldwork across hospitals and healthcare environments to observe infection control and workstation realities (shared terminals, mobile carts/WOWs, virtual desktops). Translate these user workflows, user needs, and compliance requirements into structured Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

• Commercial Ownership & Business Cases: Author and own the financial business cases for all portfolio updates and introductions, including market opportunity sizing, pricing logic, margin targets, and sales volume forecasts.

• Go-To-Market Alignment: Partner with the rest of the departments to ensure our product portfolio and value proposition are clearly articulated to channel partners and clinical customers.

What we are looking for:

• Hardware Product Management: Min. 3 years of product management experience managing physical products or hardware portfolios through their complete lifecycle, from concept and launch to phase-out.

• Portfolio & Variant Management: Practical experience managing variant-rich product lines across multiple B2B sales channels and international markets, including SKU rationalization, portfolio mapping, and master data accuracy.

• Healthcare or Clinical Context: Prior experience in medical devices, clinical IT, healthcare environments, or relevant B2B/public sector hardware is strongly preferred.

• Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong business mindset with hands-on experience modeling business cases, analyzing product margins, and defining pricing structures.

• User Discovery & Workflow Analysis: Practical experience conducting field discovery, observing end-user friction in real environments, and synthesizing findings into functional requirements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to build trust and work constructively with technical engineering teams while representing commercial realities.

• Languages & Travel: Fluent in English, with professional working proficiency in German as a strong advantage; open to international travel to our other offices & production sites (Germany and Asia), and clinical customer sites across key markets.

What We Offer:

• Direct Portfolio Ownership: End-to-end ownership of our medical and hygienic portfolio with direct visibility to leadership and a clear mandate to create operational impact.

• Professional Growth: The opportunity to build portfolio management craft within an evolving, international workplace health company.

• Central Location & Hybrid Setup: A modern office right by Vesterport Station in Vesterbro, with flexible work-from-home options.

• Benefits & Wellbeing: A strong pension scheme, gym allowance, and regular monthly team breakfasts every first Friday and Friday bars every other month.

The Recruitment Process

All applications will be reviewed and responded to on an ongoing basis. We expect to begin interviews in week 42, with interviews held on a rolling basis throughout the period. Employment start date is expected to be earliest 1 December or 1 January, depending on the notice period of the successful candidate.

What to Expect in the Recruitment Process

• Screening: A short phone call with our HR Manager (15–20 minutes)

• 1st interview: With the HR Manager and Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

• 2nd interview: With the HR Manager and Hiring Manager. You can also expect to meet our Product Manager for Active Key online via Teams during this interview.Ahead of this interview, we will ask you to prepare a case and complete a personality profile, which we will use during the interview (90 minutes)

• Skip-level interview: Teams call with the VP of Marketing (30-40 minutes)

• Job offer

About Contour

We are on a mission to make the world a healthier place to work. Headquartered in Copenhagen with 30 years in business, Contour designs and develops ergonomic workplace equipment. We invented the RollerMouse, and 9 out of 10 users report our products helped relieve their pain.

Following our acquisition of Active Key, we combine ergonomic design with specialized hygienic peripherals. We are actively expanding our portfolio and commercial presence across Europe and North America.

We are a team of around 110 people globally, large enough to have international reach, yet small enough that your work is visible, owned, and directly felt across the business.

All contact will be treated with confidentiality. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of their background and identity. Our inclusion policy applies to all employment practices within the organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Contour makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact our HR team at hr@contourdesign.com.

Or else stay updated with our latest news on LinkedIn or on our website.

The Fabrication Support team at DTU Nanolab is seeking one to two Process generalist for permanent positions. 

As a Process Generalist in the Fabrication Support team, you will be working in a highly advanced cleanroom environment. In this role, you will support and advise students and researchers at DTU and external users on fabrication processes, as well as train users in the operation of state-of-the-art semiconductor processing equipment. You will also collaborate closely with industrial partners to realize their devices, designing and executing complete fabrication processes to meet customer requirements.

The job
A significant part of your working day will be spent in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom. We are looking for a person who already has substantial experience in advanced micro-fabrication in a cleanroom environment You should enjoy helping and teaching students and other facility users to operate advanced tools. You have great attention to detail and a structured approach to developing and fine-tuning fabrication processes.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to hold a Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline with at least 3 years’ experience in semiconductor fabrication. We also expect that you are already skilled in essential nano- and microfabrication techniques such as

• UV lithography
• Thin film deposition
• Deep reactive ion etching
• Scanning electron microscopy
We also expect that you

• Can work independently on given tasks
• Will systematically document process development results
• Enjoy working on projects alone, but also in cooperation with other team members
• Are fluent in English
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a core value. We are therefore seeking candidates who are comfortable working in a highly safety-focused environment and who can meet the following physical and mental requirements:

• Comfortable wearing specialized personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
• Able to respond promptly and appropriately in emergency situations, including evacuations.
• Capable of performing duties that involve extended periods of standing and movement.
• Confident working with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases while following established safety protocols and procedures.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment. A job where you will work with state-of-the-art semiconductor fabrication equipment. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading university in Northen Europe, and our facility is among the largest and most advanced fair access facilities in Europe. Please notice that this is not a research position, it is a technical position with emphasis on user assistance and customer fabrication orders.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement for academic employees with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2026 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 15 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of Fabrication Support, Maria Matschuk on 4525 5723 or mmat@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is the National Center for Nanofabrication and Characterization in Denmark and an open-access research infrastructure at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). As one of Europe’s largest fair-access micro- and nanofabrication centers, it offers a large cleanroom and advanced electron microscopy facilities. DTU Nanolab supports cutting-edge research and small-scale production within MEMS/NEMS, photonics, and quantum technologies, covering nano- and microfabrication as well as advanced analysis of hard and soft matter. Since 2018, DTU Nanolab extended to provide expertise in soft matter from small molecule complexes to biological cells.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
